notes: Single final rendering path: FFmpeg. OpenMontage production assembly is NOT_TESTED and is not used here. Scene visuals are genuine image-to-video clips returned by the authorized provider execution (fal.ai Kling Video v3 Pro), each generated from its verified photorealistic keyframe; they are labelled provider-generated image-to-video, never locally animated stills. FFmpeg is used only for codec/resolution/framerate conversion, audio mixing, cutting, concatenation, transitions, and final encoding. No still-zoompan fallback exists for this project's required clips: without authorized real clips the driver fails closed and produces no final video. The eight 6 s clips give 48 s of video; the schedule is video-led and computed from the measured narration durations at assembly time.
